content_html: Taiwanese pianist Li-Ying Chang graduated with a Master of Music in Piano Performance from Peabody Conservatory, under the tutelage of Benjamin Pasternack. As a musician, she believes in and seeks to share the transcendentally expressive power of music. Chang is currently active as a solo pianist, chamber musician, teacher, and accompanist in the Chicago area.

Taiwanese pianist Li-Ying Chang graduated with a Master of Music in Piano Performance from Peabody Conservatory, under the tutelage of Benjamin Pasternack. As a musician, she believes in and seeks to share the transcendentally expressive power of music. Chang is currently active as a solo pianist, chamber musician, teacher, and accompanist in the Chicago area.
